title: Make the oversized task-sync progress state refusal name an actionable next step
outcome: Make the oversized task-sync progress state refusal name an actionable next step
acceptance: The refusal journal::publish raises when serialized preparation metadata exceeds STATE_LIMIT states that preparation metadata exceeded its internal bound, that nothing was published and existing progress is unchanged, and asks the agent to report it with the byte count; it no longer tells the agent to shorten the capture reason or reduce the omitted entries, which no caller controls.
The state_limit regression tests assert the new wording through the error's Display.

completion.summary:
Landed 5a7415d on master. The oversized preparation-metadata refusal is now a plain error: "task-sync preparation metadata is {N} bytes, over Engram's internal {STATE_LIMIT}-byte bound; nothing was published, and the existing progress generations and output are unchanged. This is an Engram defect: report it with this byte count." The uncontrollable remedy and the false "local work input is invalid" prefix are gone. The state_limit tests assert the exact Display and a single-cause chain, matching the one CLI "error:" line, and keep the whole-home equality that proves the preservation claim.
